column1: # Hebrew interface catalogue. english<TAB>translation; a line left out, or
# left empty, falls through to the English.
# Written right to left. Liberation Sans, which ships with Deckboy, has the
# Hebrew letters, so it reads on every machine with no #font line; the shaper
# lays each label out with the Unicode bidi algorithm, so a Latin word or a
# number inside it keeps its own direction.
# Buttons are nouns of action -- שמירה, פתיחה -- which address nobody in
# particular, as Hebrew interfaces now do; prompts use יש ל. A cue is a קיו,
# as the theatre says it. TAKE and PROGRAM stay in English, as in every
# NOT YET REVIEWED BY A HEBREW SPEAKER: written without one, so the picker
# says so. Corrections are very welcome.
